description: Change screening Autopilot. Change the employer's own Screening Autopilot, at their request: acknowledge_every_applicant (a thank-you to each applicant), shortlist_at_match (50 to 97: applicants at or above it are moved to the shortlist for the employer to review; nobody is hired or rejected by score), turn_down_after_days (7 to 60: a polite turn-down, with turn_down_note, to applicants still undecided after that many days). Turning on turn-downs is held: the first call returns a summary and a confirmation_token, and nothing changes until the employer agrees. A ready-to-read summary is in `say`.

confirmation_token.description: The token from a held answer, sent with exactly the same other inputs once the person has agreed to its summary.

name: set_screening_autopilot
title: Change screening Autopilot
